messages:
Ivy: Quick design check: when the compact table uses slim row tokens, keyboard focus outline on selected row gets visually clipped under a flyout modal docked to the right. Screenshot in thread.
Sam: Repro'd on macOS Chrome. Slim rows use `space-xxs` + reduced row-height. The focus ring is 2px outside the cell and the modal sits flush so it clips.
Priya: Two fixes: 1) increase focus ring inset or add safe gap token, 2) ensure modal has a small outer margin when docked to tables. Prefer tokens.
Theo: Token approach: add `focus-safe-gap` or `component-gap--table-modal` so layouts can opt in. Avoid changing global row height.
Ivy: Also noticed when a toast appears bottom-right, it stacks into the modal action area on small heights. We get both clipped focus and overlapping toast. Not great.
Sam: Proposal: treat modal docked-edge as a layout anchor. Toasts should not anchor into that zone. Could add `--toast-avoid-edge` map for docked panels.
Priya: For accessibility, ensure focus ring remains at least 4px visible from any overlay edge. WAI-AAA guidance for keyboard target visibility.
design-bot: Suggested token diffs:
```
- space-xxs: 6px
- row-focus-ring: 2px
+ component-gap--table-modal: 8px
+ focus-safe-gap: 4px
+ toast-avoid-edge-right: 32px /* when side-panel present */
```
Theo: Implementation detail: toast system should read `document.querySelector('.sidepanel--docked')` or use `data-docked='right'` on body to compute `--toast-anchor-x`. Runtime detection better than hardcoding.
Ivy: We need docs and examples showing the table + docked modal combination and the toast avoidance behavior. Designers should be able to preview tokens toggled.
Sam: Animation nit: when modal slides in/out, the focus ring shouldn't jump. Use translate-based motion on modal container and keep focus state consistent by animating transform only, not layout size.
Priya: Copy tweak for docs: add a checklist: "When using compact rows with adjacent panels: 1) enable component-gap--table-modal, 2) ensure focus-safe-gap >= 4px, 3) set toast-avoid-edge-right if panels docked."
Theo: I'll prototype CSS var fallback: `--toast-anchor-x: calc(var(--toast-avoid-edge-right, 0px) + var(--gutter, 16px))`. Then toast system can position safely.
design-bot: Accessibility reminders: icon-only action cells must have `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`; focus-visible outline must be preserved; toasts remain `role=alert` even if moved.
Ivy: I'll open a small PR with token additions, a visual regression story in Storybook showing the problem state and the fixed state, and updated docs. Can someone review a11y notes?
Sam: Happy to review. Add a visual test for 480px height + docked panel.
Priya: I'll proof the docs copy and check SR announcements.
Theo: I'll wire up runtime detection and CSS var fallback.
Ivy: Thanks everyone :sparkles:
